name: master_empirical_procedural_graph
description: Unified Master Procedural Graph synthesized from 2,674 Kaggle matches via 4-arm MAB parallel distillation, calibrated to Grandmaster benchmarks (Median Reward: $159,626.0).

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Evaluates net available cash, current step/day/hour, shed fill percentage, wage liabilities, active town shop demand windows, and 96-step oracle supply curves.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces emergency surplus liquidation when hour >= 18 and net available cash is below the mandatory wage threshold (hands_count * 120 + 100).

nodes.name: Terminal Asset Liquidation
nodes.description: Full-spectrum fire sale executing from step 700 to 719. Dumps 100% of shed inventory, feeds, and carried produce into cash before step 720 game termination.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing low-margin bulk inventory when shed capacity approaches the empirical peak median of 96.0.

nodes.name: Town Shop Arbitrage & Scarcity Capture
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop contracts (Carrots, Tomatoes, Strawberries, Milk, Eggs) to extract 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Hoards Tomatoes for Days 27-29 nonlinear shortage spikes ($750+/unit) and routes heavy Strawberry/Milk volume into Ice Cream and Brunch shops.

nodes.name: Early Capital Compounding
nodes.description: Days 0-10.9 growth engine: executes Day 0 foundational acquisition (5.0 hands, 9.0 cows, 5.0 sheep), compounds Strawberry plots, and scales peak workforce up to 12.0 hands while strictly preserving payroll reserves.

nodes.name: Late Harvest Freeze & Regrowth Watering Loop
nodes.description: Enacted at Day 11.0 (step 264): permanently freezes Strawberry seed buys and land expansion, locking hands into an uninterrupted watering loop to exploit 3-day regrowth cycles.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Monitors 96-step predictive supply curves to liquidate livestock luxury goods (Wool, Milk) ahead of competitor-induced market gluts.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes physical farm tasks: dispatches workers strictly to Strawberry watering, ready-crop harvesting, and livestock feeding in priority sequence.

attributes.condition: hour >= 18 and day > 1 and step < 700 and net_available_cash < (hands_count * 120 + 100)
attributes.guidance: Cancel all non-essential purchases immediately. Execute emergency batch sales of non-feed inventory to ensure cash strictly exceeds (hands_count * 120 + 100) before midnight hour 24.
attributes.pitfalls: Fatal liquidity collapse occurs if this threshold is missed. Never trigger on Day 0-1 when initial capital ($3,000) is abundant; never liquidate Wheat below minimum livestock survival threshold.

attributes.guidance: Execute unconditional liquidation across all inventory, unplanted seeds, animal feed, and crops. Command all hands to drop carried items immediately into shed and sell on open market before step 720.
attributes.pitfalls: Holding inventory past step 719 anticipating higher shop demand; leaving harvested crops inside worker packs during the final simulation tick; holding animal feed into terminal horizon.

attributes.guidance: Immediately clear low-margin or high-volume bulk inventory (excess Fertilizer, Wood, surplus Wheat) to maintain headroom below the empirical peak shed median of 96.0 before workers deliver crops, preventing silent 100/100 discards.
attributes.pitfalls: Never evict feed Wheat when animals are hungry (maintain a minimum 6-hour feed buffer); do not wait until shed reaches 100 capacity before triggering relief.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and net_available_cash >= (hands_count * 120 + 100) and step < 700 and (any(s.demands_item_in_shed and s.multiplier >= 1.8 for s in active_shops) or (day >= 27 and shed.get('Tomato', 0) > 0 and shop_active('TownShop')) or (shed.get('Strawberry', 0) >= 20 and shop_active('IceCreamShop')) or (shed.get('Milk', 0) >= 15 and shop_active('BrunchShop')))
attributes.guidance: Prioritize direct town shop fulfillment over open market sales to capture 2.0x-3.5x pricing multipliers. Direct bulk Strawberries and Milk specifically into Ice Cream and Brunch venues (700+ units delivered). Hoard Tomatoes in shed until Days 27-29 to exploit terminal nonlinear scarcity price spikes exceeding $750+/unit ($757 meta). Satisfy daily Carrot and Egg quotas without exceeding requested batch sizes.
attributes.pitfalls: Never dump Tomatoes or Strawberries at wholesale baseline prices between Days 15-26 if town shops are active; never compromise midnight wage reserve buffer; do not purchase shop-targeted crop seeds after Day 20 if maturation cycle exceeds remaining game steps; ensure all held scarcity stock is liquidated prior to hour 20 on Day 29.

attributes.condition: day < 11.0 and (day == 0 or (net_available_cash > (hands_count * 120 + 200) and (hands_count < 12 or cows_count < 9 or sheep_count < 5 or plots_expandable)))
attributes.guidance: On Day 0, immediately hire 5.0 hands, acquire up to 9.0 cows and 5.0 sheep, and plant Strawberries. On Days 1-10.9, progressively expand peak workforce up to 12.0 hands and expand Strawberry plots whenever free cash exceeds payroll reserve plus buffer (hands_count * 120 + 200).
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase Strawberry seeds on or after Day 11.0 (step 264) as they will not mature before the game horizon; never exceed 12 active hands; do not acquire livestock without securing feed grass/wheat reserves; never compromise midnight payroll cash buffer for speculative seed purchases.

attributes.guidance: Enacted at Day 11.0 (step 264): permanently freeze all Strawberry seed purchases, new land tilling, and land expansion. Reassign 100% of non-harvest worker AP into a continuous cyclic watering loop to sustain the 3-day Strawberry regrowth cycles and maximize yield throughput until terminal liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Purchasing Strawberry seeds after Day 11.0 (fails payback horizon); missing daily watering ticks on mature Strawberry plots which delays or resets the 3-day regrowth cycle; sending hands to till empty soil when mature plants require watering.

attributes.condition: oracle_glut_risk >= 0.30 and current_price >= 0.60 * base_price and step < 700
attributes.guidance: Monitor 96-step predictive supply curves (TTM forecast) to preemptively dump luxury commodities (Wool, Milk) before opponent market gluts collapse open market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Dumping into markets that have already collapsed to baseline ($1.00); selling commodities allocated for imminent high-multiplier Town Shop orders; selling off feed Wheat reserves.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch idle hands to physical farm routines in strict priority order: Strawberry plot watering, ready-crop harvesting, livestock feeding, and shed delivery.
attributes.pitfalls: Leaving mature Strawberry beds unwatered; allowing hands to hold carried items without dropping them into the shed before turn transitions; neglecting livestock feeding cycles.
